scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run test:tooling && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:smoke
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run architecture:check && npm run build && npm test
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names client,server "npm run dev --workspace @zombi-survive/client" "npm run dev --workspace @zombi-survive/server"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @zombi-survive/client && npm run build --workspace @zombi-survive/server
scripts.build:contracts: npm run build --workspace @zombi-survive/domain && npm run build --workspace @zombi-survive/protocol
